listed_sector_signals.signal: Empirical survey covers Turkish iron and steel sector, including integrated steel plants and electric arc furnaces (primary-metals continuous production)
listed_sector_signals.quote:
In Turkey, there are 3 integrated steel plants,
Eregli Iron and Steel Works Co. (Erdemir), _Iskenderun Iron and Steel
Works Co. (_Isdemir) and Karabük Iron and Steel Works Co.
(Kardemir), and 18 electric arc furnaces which produce steel from
scrap metal.
listed_sector_signals.sector: steel and other primary-metals continuous production

listed_sector_signals.signal: Cement sector surveyed; clinker and cement production described as energy-intensive process
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The cement sector in Turkey produces mainly intermediate
products, clinker and cement as the ﬁnal product.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Paper and pulp plants surveyed; paper produced from pulp described as energy-intensive production process
listed_sector_signals.quote:
There are currently 38 paper and pulp plants in Turkey [9]. A
large number of plants in Turkey produce paper from pulp and
these production processes are more energy intensive compared to
other
paper
production
methods

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Ceramics sector included in survey as an energy-intensive industry (ceramics/kiln processing)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Accounting for 11% of total ceramics production in Europe, the
ceramics sector is also an essential industrial sector in Turkey.

one_line: A questionnaire-based multiple case study assessing corporate energy management maturity across Turkish energy-intensive industries (iron/steel, cement, paper & pulp, ceramics, textile), focused on management practices rather than continuous-production processes.
